body.description: WREN, a teenage girl, young scavenger hero of post-collapse Texas: blonde hair in a low ponytail under a worn leather cap with brass goggles pushed up, red bandana at the neck, scuffed tan work jacket with a salvaged metal shoulder pad, patched denim trousers with knee pads, worn brown boots, tool pouch on belt, determined hopeful face
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
